d.ko: Esoteric Ebb is a single-player CRPG inspired by the freedom of tabletop adventures. Unravel a political conspiracy with your goblin sidekick. Roll dice in tense encounters. Become a cleric of legends or completely ruin the campaign.

d.zh: 《奥秘消退 (Esoteric Ebb) 》是一款等距视角单人RPG游戏。与你的哥布林伙伴一起揭开一场政治阴谋。掷骰子，做出紧张刺激的选择，并探索一个即将迎来首次选举的城市。成为传说中的神职人员，或彻底破坏这场战役。
